text: すてきな　ポケモンを　そだててるのね

structure.jp: すてきな　ポケモンを

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: てる is the shortened spoken form of ている, which shows something that is going on now. そだててる = 'are raising'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: の at the end is a soft, womanly way of saying のだ, with the feeling of 'I see that...'. そだててるのね = 'so you're raising them, aren't you'.
